Getting started with spainpolls

getting-started.Rmd
library(spainpolls)

Elections, Pollsters and Parties 

elections <- get_elections(limit = 10)

pollsters <- get_pollsters(
  election_key = "congreso_espana_2026"
)

parties <- get_parties(
  election_key = "congreso_espana_2026"
)

Polls 

polls <- get_polls(
  election_key = "congreso_espana_2026",
  limit = 20
)

one_poll <- get_poll(101)
one_poll_results <- get_poll_results(101)

Results

get_results() returns one row per poll and party.

results <- get_results(
  election_key = "congreso_espana_2026",
  collect_all = TRUE
)

Time Series 

ts <- get_timeseries(
  election_key = "congreso_espana_2026",
  party = "psoe",
  date_field = "auto"
)

Analysis with dplyr 

library(dplyr)

get_results(election_key = "congreso_espana_2026", collect_all = TRUE) |>
  filter(party_key %in% c("psoe", "pp", "vox", "sumar")) |>
  group_by(party_key) |>
  summarise(mean_vote = mean(vote_share, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

Plotting with ggplot2 

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

ts <- get_timeseries(
  election_key = "congreso_espana_2026",
  date_field = "fieldwork_end", 
  party_key = c("psoe", "pp", "vox", "sumar"),
  collect_all = T, 
  include_manual_review = T
)

ts |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = vote_share, fill = color_hex, color = color_hex, group = short_name)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, alpha = .3) +
  geom_smooth(span = .1, alpha = .2) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = date, y = vote_share), 
    data = plot_data,
    alpha = .1
  ) + 
  scale_color_identity(aesthetics = c("color", "fill")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Vote share (%)")

Pagination

All list endpoints are paginated. Use limit and offset for one page, or collect_all = TRUE to download all matching pages:

all_polls <- get_polls(
  election_key = "congreso_espana_2026",
  collect_all = TRUE
)

When collecting all rows, spainpolls starts at offset 0 and stops when the API reports that all matching rows have been downloaded.
